# Black Order

A browser-based first-person war game set in 2015, in which a secret organization descended from Nazi structures,
**the Black Order**, re-emerges from its mountain bases. You play a special-forces soldier. The whole game is a
**single HTML file** (Three.js r128, no external assets: textures, models and sounds are generated by code) and it
also supports **online co-op for up to 3 players** and a team match against bots.

> Working title in the original (Czech) conversations: *Černý řád*. The project is now documented and maintained in English.

## Play

* Open `web/dist/black-order.html` in a modern desktop browser (Chrome, Edge or Firefox). The file loads Three.js from cdnjs, so it needs internet access.
* Or open the published copy: <https://claude.ai/artifact/8XE7Jw8VNY6rUzxVdT6UZP> (a claude.ai artifact; online multiplayer only works there, see [docs/MULTIPLAYER.md](docs/MULTIPLAYER.md)).
* Click inside the game to capture the mouse. `Esc` pauses.

| Key | Action |
|---|---|
| W A S D | move (in the helicopter: W/S climb and descend) |
| Shift (left or right) | sprint |
| Space | jump (in vehicles: fire) |
| Mouse / left button | look / fire |
| Right button | aim down sights (helicopter: cycle weapon) |
| R | reload |
| 1–4 | primary, secondary, melee, grenade (campaign 2: **5 = RPG**; helicopter: 1–3 select weapon) |
| E | board / exit the helicopter |
| Q | Training only: switch to the next weapon in the slot |
| Esc | pause |

## What is in the game

* **Two campaigns** (6 missions): *Black Order* (infantry) and *Steel Fist* (armored vehicles, helicopters, jets, desert maps).
* **22 weapons** in four slots (primary, secondary, melee, grenade) and a Store (currencies: Weapoints and medals).
* **Enemy vehicles**: 8x8 APCs, T-14-style tanks, attack helicopters, jets that bomb your position. Bullets barely scratch armor; explosives hurt.
* **Player helicopter** (Mi-24 look, campaign 2 only) with machine gun, rocket pods and anti-tank missiles, and **2 AI allies**.
* **Quick games**: Training (shooting range), Survival (endless waves), Team Match vs bots.
* **Multiplayer** (claude.ai artifact runtime): co-op campaign for 1–3 players (human players replace the AI allies) and Team Match.

Details: [docs/GAME_DESIGN.md](docs/GAME_DESIGN.md).

## Repository layout

```
web/src/            source of the browser game (template, CSS, 17 numbered JS modules)
web/dist/           built single-file game (committed so it can be played without building)
tools/build.py      concatenates web/src into web/dist/black-order.html
tests/              headless tests (jsdom, mock multiplayer room) and the test harness
engines/unreal/     Unreal Engine 5.4 C++ project (feature-behind, open build issue)
engines/godot/      Godot 4.3 port (archived at an early prototype level)
drafts/v1.1/        written but NOT yet integrated extension (perks, zombie arena, objectives, ...)
docs/               architecture, design, multiplayer protocol, development guide, roadmap, diary
AGENTS.md           instructions for AI coding agents (Claude Code, Codex, ...)
```

## Quick start for developers

```bash
npm install            # jsdom + three@0.128.0 (test dependencies only)
npm run build          # python3 tools/build.py  ->  web/dist/black-order.html
npm test               # builds, then runs every tests/*.test.js
```

Requirements: Node >= 20, Python 3. The game itself has **no build dependencies**; the build script only concatenates files.

## Status and honesty notes

* Game **logic** is covered by headless tests. **Visuals and performance have never been inspected by the AI that wrote most of the code**; the project owner has played it.
* Online multiplayer was verified only with an in-memory mock of the room API, not with real remote players.
* License: not chosen yet (all rights reserved by default). Add a `LICENSE` file before publishing publicly.
